name: ARE 4900
title: Farm Credit Fellows Seminar
description: Course offered with Farm Credit East. Students learn agribusiness concepts from the lender's perspective. Students taking this course will be assigned a grade of S (satisfactory) or U (unsatisfactory).
requirement_description: One or more of the following courses: ARE 2150, 2210, 2215; ACCT 2001; BADM 3730; or FNCE 3101.
